note: Registered cells. Endpoints: caught = the fraction of a defect instance's ledgers in the stratum (the one literal ledger, or the thirty random ledgers at n) in which the replay mismatched at least one row; lineMovedWhenCaught = among the caught ledgers, the fraction whose profile carries the line-moved signature (PREREGISTRATION.md section 5), allowsNoCaught where a registration expects no catch. Every expectation is derived from the pack's text and the runtime's documented semantics under the structures named in section 6; the structure and the reason are recorded per cell. Cells not registered here are reported descriptively (R2) and decide nothing.
